definitions.explanation: Eating meat, or the practice of eating meat. Used both for animals (carnivorous) and humans (meat-eating diet).
Slang describing someone who is aggressive or proactive in pursuing romantic or sexual relationships. Contrasted with {草食|そうしょく} (herbivore), which describes passive, unassertive people.

examples.japanese: ライオンは{肉食|にくしょく}{動物|どうぶつ}だ。
{肉食|にくしょく}を{控|ひか}えて{野菜|やさい}{中心|ちゅうしん}の{食事|しょくじ}にした。
examples.english: I cut back on meat and switched to a vegetable-based diet.

examples.japanese: {恐竜|きょうりゅう}の{中|なか}には{肉食|にくしょく}と{草食|そうしょく}の{両方|りょうほう}がいたことが{化石|かせき}から{分|わ}かっている。
examples.english: It is known from fossils that there were both carnivorous and herbivorous dinosaurs.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{肉食|にくしょく}{系|けい}だから、すぐ{声|こえ}をかける。
examples.english: He's the aggressive type, so he'll approach someone right away.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}は{肉食|にくしょく}{系|けい}{女子|じょし}が{増|ふ}えたと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It's said that assertive women have been increasing recently.

examples.japanese: {草食|そうしょく}{系|けい}の{男性|だんせい}が{増|ふ}える{一方|いっぽう}で、{肉食|にくしょく}{系|けい}の{女性|じょせい}も{目立|めだ}つようになってきた。
examples.english: While passive men are on the rise, assertive women have also become more noticeable.

notes:
USAGE NOTE:
Sense 2 became widespread around the late 2000s as part of the {草食|そうしょく}{系|けい}/{肉食|にくしょく}{系|けい} typology used to describe dating attitudes. The contrast is: {肉食|にくしょく}{系|けい} = aggressive, proactive; {草食|そうしょく}{系|けい} = passive, uninterested.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肉食|にくしょく}{動物|どうぶつ} (carnivore, meat-eating animal)
- {肉食|にくしょく}{系|けい} (aggressive type, carnivore type)
- {肉食|にくしょく}{系|けい}{男子|だんし}/{女子|じょし} (assertive man/woman)
- {肉食|にくしょく}を{控|ひか}える (cut back on meat)

CONTRAST:
- {草食|そうしょく}: herbivorous; passive/unassertive (in dating context)
